title: Dread Pirate Robbie
theme: Title cut · scene callouts / Dread Pirate Roberts
description: A 2026 title cut, Dread Pirate Robbie sends a volley at Bitcoin's loudest claims. Craig Wright's Satoshi story is waved off while hashrate, a majority attack, and wrecked funds then take the next bars. The hook wears the Dread Pirate Roberts name — Silk Road, Ross Ulbricht, and whoever is left to answer for it. The mask stays on.
